question.text: The Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) requires Research Analysts to:

answer.text: Comply with CSCRF, covering the five cyber resiliency goals (anticipate, withstand, contain, recover and evolve), implemented through cybersecurity controls

explanation.text: The Logic: Research Analysts must comply with the CSCRF, which is structured around five cyber resiliency goals: anticipate, withstand, contain, recover and evolve. These goals are implemented through cybersecurity controls applicable to the RA's operations. The Trap: Limiting cybersecurity to antivirus software, password protection or monthly backups misses the resiliency framework that CSCRF mandates. Note: Remember the five resiliency goals using the mnemonic "Anticipate-Withstand-Contain-Recover-Evolve". CSCRF expects each RA to implement cybersecurity controls that map to all five goals, not just one or two.
